name: Making Fun
overview: Scripture warns against making fun of others, especially the poor and those who suffer, equating such mockery with reproaching the Creator Himself. The wise are called to hold their peace rather than despise their neighbors, recognizing that mockery stems from folly and a lack of understanding. Those who delight in the misfortunes of others invite God's judgment, as scornful attitudes align with the counsel of the ungodly rather than the favor granted to the righteous.
